newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to offer seven-yr bonds of HUF 5 bln. [CORRECTED 14:31 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hungary to offer seven-yr bonds of HUF 5 bln. [CORRECTED 14:31 GMT]

text.p: Hungary will auction five billion forint worth of the seven-year government bonds of 2004/G series on July 31, the Government Debt Management Agency (AKK) said on Monday.
(Correcting the date of average price at last auction to July 3 from April 10)
NOTE - The bond bears a floating interest, calculated
every half year, adding three percent to year-on-year consumer inflation. The interest is paid once a year, on March 24. The starting interest is 20.7 percent.
